run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable over 100 iterations and print average time in milliseconds
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup phase that runs 5 iterations before timing begins
test_time_func_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations to measure performance
review_time_func_timing: review time_func which uses perf_counter to measure average execution time per call
summarize_time_func_output: summarize time_func output that prints the named function and its average time in ms
